text:
Priya Nair: Quick design review request — updated mock (roles grid + invite flow + SSO toggle + audit nav). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/org-access-grid — please skim and drop :eyes: by EOD if possible. Main asks below.

Marta Rivera: Looking now. quick note: the grid feels dense at 1280px with 5 columns. Can we collapse less-used perms into a hover detail?

Priya Nair: @Marta Rivera good call. Proposal: default condensed view + an expand chevron per role to reveal permission checkboxes. That keeps vertical rhythm. Thoughts?

Josh Kim: Condensed works. From engineering: expanding client-side is cheap. only ask is to keep DOM order stable for keyboard nav.

Laura Chen: on copy — invite CTA currently "Invite team". Feels generic. Suggest: primary CTA "Invite members" and secondary "Create invite link" (tooltip: link expires after 24h).

Aaron Li: API note: we already have link creation endpoint with expiry param. If UX adds tooltip we can autofill expiry options (1h, 24h, 7d).

Samir Patel: SSO toggle language: right now it says "Enable SSO (SAML)" — customers asked for clearer consequences. Suggest copy: `Enforce SSO for all org members (recommended for security)` when toggle on vs `Allow password sign-in and SSO` when off.

Marta Rivera: I like that. UI-wise maybe show a small warning badge when turning on: "Turning this on will sign out active sessions that aren't SSO" with a link to docs.

Priya Nair: Good. Also audit log nav: currently pagination uses infinite scroll in the modal which makes find-by-timestamp hard. Can we switch to cursor-based paging + an explicit "Load more" button and sticky time-range filter?

Josh Kim: Cursor pagination + Load more is straightforward. Sticky filter is a little more CSS but doable. Also suggest enabling server-side index by event_time for faster seeks.

Laura Chen: Accessibility nit: audit rows need better focus states. Right now focus only outlines the row, but the action buttons are not reachable without extra tab stops. We should ensure action buttons receive focus and have visible labels.

Accessibility Bot: a11y check: ensure role="table" and proper aria-sort on timestamp column if sortable. For the expand chevron, use aria-expanded and keyboard handler on Enter/Space. Also provide skip link to jump to filter controls.

Aaron Li: Dev question: for the condensed role grid, will permissions be represented as boolean toggles in the DOM? If so we need API batch endpoints to update multiple perms at once to avoid N calls.

Priya Nair: Yes, intention is batch updates per role. UX should show a brief toast "Changes saved" and an undo snackbar for 5s.

Samir Patel: Microcopy for undo: `Changes saved — undo` (primary action). For error: `Failed to update permissions. Try again or contact support.`

Marta Rivera: A few visual proposals in Figma: 1) compact grid with chevrons 2) two-column layout on smaller screens 3) modal for bulk-invite. I uploaded variants in the file.

Josh Kim: I'll prep a tiny prototype for keyboard interactions (focus, expand, batch save) tomorrow.

Laura Chen: I'll run a quick 5-minute accessibility pass and list any missing ARIA attributes.

Priya Nair: Thanks all — please add short comments in the Figma file (use the "UX-REVIEW" tag) rather than long threads. If no objections I'll lock the spec Wednesday and hand to eng for sprint planning.

Samir Patel: no objections from growth POV. minor ask: include analytics hook for invite CTA clicks + SSO toggle changes.

Aaron Li: noted — add event names and schema in the spec and we'll implement.

Marta Rivera: small copy tweak suggestion for bulk-invite modal heading: `Invite members and assign roles` instead of `Invite team members`. clearer intent.

Priya Nair: Great — I'll update the figma copy and post a follow-up. TY! :tada:
